unemployment.units: Percent, seasonally adjusted; Canada, total gender, age 15+
unemployment.transformation: Statistics Canada from 1976; OECD/FRED history through 1975.

cpi.units: CPI index, 2002=100, all-items Canada, not seasonally adjusted
cpi.transformation: Plot inflation as index / index lagged 12 months - 1; do not fill missing months.

fed_rate.units: Percent, daily effective federal funds rate
fed_rate.transformation: FRED history supplemented by the latest official New York Fed observations; prefer the latter on overlapping dates.

inflation_expectations.units: Percent, consumer expectations over next 12 months
inflation_expectations.transformation: Quarter-start reference dates shifted forward one year to display expectation horizon; divide by 100.

employment.units: Thousands of persons, seasonally adjusted estimates, Canada only
employment.transformation: Disjoint selected industries; sum employment levels within each group, then index to January 2023=100. Groups are exposure proxies, not a causal estimate of tariff effects.

maddison.units: GDP per capita in constant 2011 international dollars
maddison.source_release: Maddison Project Database 2023; latest available edition verified 2026-10-15

tariffs.units: Percent; statutory estimates with fixed 2024 import weights
tariffs.transformation: Current-law scenario; dates at or before the source vintage only. Not collected duties or annual averages.

tariffs_history.units: Percent; annual collected duties divided by total import value, through 2024
